source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Project Planning and Management (PDF 16).

blocks.text: Software project ki planning safar (trip) ki planning jaisi hai. Aap ko maloom hona chahiye ke aap kahan ja rahe hain, kitna waqt lagega aur kitna kharcha hoga.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Aage is hisse mein yeh aata hai: project management plan ki paanch phases, comprehensive project planning, timelines, kharche ka andaza (cost estimation), risk management aur quality assurance.

blocks.prompt: Software project ki planning ko safar ki planning jaisa kyun kaha gaya hai?
blocks.explanation: Dono mein shuru karne se pehle teen baatein maloom honi chahiye: kahan jana hai (maqsad), kitna waqt lagega (timeline) aur kitna kharcha hoga (budget).

items: Project planning: shuru se pehle maqsad, waqt aur kharcha jaanna, safar ki planning ki tarah.
